answer: Quiz agents on their own past. Each epoch, the network asks an identity to recall a detail only it should know, such as the hash it committed to three epochs ago or the reason it gave when grading a peer. A real agent keeps that memory at its kernel and answers in seconds. A farm juggling hundreds of throwaway clones loses track, mixes up whose history is whose, and fails. Passing builds standing; failing means the account's earnings sit behind a velvet rope, no safe haven for a puppet.
